posts.title: XHR by CEM, The data request API made right.
posts.description: The theory and practical way. An HTTP response, a local file, and a string supplied by an application all enter CEM through the same import boundary. CEM-ML selects the parser for the input format, decodes the source, and builds a typed document tree.
